# Generated story material - do not edit

Apart from `index-dev.html`, every file in this directory is generated by `npm run story`, which runs
`src/js/storyBuild.js` over the story's knitted R Markdown:

    node src/js/storyBuild.js content/story viz_data static/story

Edits made here are overwritten the next time it runs. To change a pane, edit its R Markdown in `content/story/` and
knit it again - its front matter names `R/knit_render.R` as its knit function - then run `npm run story`.

## Where each file comes from

- `<pane>.html`, e.g. `Solow.html`, is the section of `content/story/<pane>.html`, the page R knits from
  `content/story/<pane>.Rmd`. The pandoc page around it is removed, and so is the data of its map widgets, which goes
  into `mapData.json`.
- `<pane>-data.html`, e.g. `History-data.html`, holds the pane's widgets which bear an `mx_widgetId`. These are shown
  in the data area beside the map.
- `panes.json` has one record for each pane, in order of the `weight` of its front matter. It holds the pane's front
  matter and file names, and any members of `viz_data/<pane>-mapData.json`.
- `mapData.json` is a single map style holding every source and layer of every pane's map once, together with each
  pane's layers, camera and fill patterns.
- `img/` holds copies of the images the panes' sections refer to, taken from `content/story/`.

The story page, `static/bioreportr/sfc/bioreportr-storyPage.vue`, fetches these files. Hugo publishes them unchanged.

## Not generated

`index-dev.html` is written by hand. It is a development page for the story, standing in for the page Hugo renders
from `layouts/story/baseof.html`.
